entries.text: You see Amber, a teacher for the Followers.
entries.source_text: You see Amber, a teacher for the Followers.

entries.text: Now is when I rest. Please, come back during the evening.
entries.source_text: Now is when I rest. Please, come back during the evening.

entries.text: Welcome noble traveler. Have you come here to study?
entries.source_text: Welcome noble traveler. Have you come here to study?

entries.text: No. I really came here just to kill things.
entries.source_text: No. I really came here just to kill things.

entries.text: Depends on what you want to teach me.
entries.source_text: Depends on what you want to teach me.

entries.text: Yes, I am willing to learn.
entries.source_text: Yes, I am willing to learn.

entries.text: I am truly sorry to hear that. The Followers believe in peace at all costs. For that reason, I have renounced violence. Good evening.
entries.source_text:
I am truly sorry to hear that. The Followers believe in peace at all
 costs. For that reason, I have renounced violence. Good evening.

entries.text: I am skilled in many of the languages and arts. Perhaps you would like to learn one of those?
entries.source_text:
I am skilled in many of the languages and arts. Perhaps you would like

entries.text: I'm sorry, but I need to know things which will help me survive.
entries.source_text: I'm sorry, but I need to know things which will help me survive.

entries.text: I have no time for that type of stuff. I'm gone.
entries.source_text: I have no time for that type of stuff. I'm gone.

entries.text: Perhaps I can listen to a song or two.
entries.source_text: Perhaps I can listen to a song or two.

entries.text: Can you teach me anything else?
entries.source_text: Can you teach me anything else?

entries.text: Ah, we have here a student of life. In a case like this, I can teach you some herbalism, but training takes a while for little result.
entries.source_text:

entries.text: Fine, just teach me.
entries.source_text: Fine, just teach me.

entries.text: Please, teach me what you can.
entries.source_text: Please, teach me what you can.

entries.text: Sorry, I really don't have time for plants. Goodbye.
entries.source_text: Sorry, I really don't have time for plants. Goodbye.

entries.text: You need not be rude. Apologize now, or I won't teach you.
entries.source_text: You need not be rude. Apologize now, or I won't teach you.

entries.text: I am sorry. Will you please teach me?
entries.source_text: I am sorry. Will you please teach me?

entries.text: Forget it.
entries.source_text: Forget it.

entries.text: That is better now. We will begin your studies.
entries.source_text: That is better now. We will begin your studies.

entries.text: You are an apt learner. May your trials be light. Go in peace.
entries.source_text: You are an apt learner. May your trials be light. Go in peace.

entries.text: As you see fit. May the future soften your heart and broaden your mind.
entries.source_text: As you see fit. May the future soften your heart and broaden your mind.

entries.text: Very well, I will teach you the ways to survive.
entries.source_text: Very well, I will teach you the ways to survive.

entries.text: You do not convince me. I think you seek to use my gifts for ill. Good evening.
entries.source_text:
You do not convince me. I think you seek to use my gifts for ill.
 Good evening.

entries.text: Ah, a student of the arts is a rare thing in this world. Perhaps there is hope for you yet. Each song is long in time. Which would you like to hear?

entries.text: In the Wake of the Shadow.

entries.text: An astonishing piece of work. I shall grant you an audience.

entries.text: I fear I have spent myself far too much. I am sorry.

entries.text: Peace and Beauty are all I can teach. I am sorry that those are not appealing to you. Good day.

entries.text: I can teach you the ways of the old bards and minstrels.

entries.text: I would be honored to hear a song.

entries.text: Perhaps another time. Thank you.

entries.text: I was hoping to learn something that may help me more.

entries.text: You have no need of my talents. You have taught peaceful people the ways of war. I mourn for them now.
